limitations: State partition changes logical owners, not neuron count or tensor shape
Materialization recombines one module; no distributed successor inference is qualified
RNG, LR scheduler and live hidden state are excluded; fresh-episode templates required
CPU/wall include work inside each adapter attempt; full process, reporting and dependency costs remain outside this qualification
Byte counters distinguish tensor payload, Torch archives and complete in-memory JSON serializations; none are measured physical traffic
The 64 MiB cap is per encoded object and checked after encoding, not a process or aggregate memory budget; retained traces grow with transfers
No independent owner authentication or prospective efficacy registration is established
Local test evidence is not proof that hosted CI has already run
source_snapshot_timing: Each version was copied and hashed before its corresponding tests; current source matches final pre-test snapshot.
